source_policy: AST functions unchanged in RAM from pinned local code; no upstream vendoring

simple_main.fixed: source main.py + adapter six channels + Network_Latency; canonical services; P3 5N5A; generator log message extraction; time kept

factors.M0: literal generator duration (native microseconds passed unchanged)
factors.M1: M0 with duration *1000 to honor source comment nanoseconds
factors.M2: M1 with timestamp datetime alias for log frequency duration only

orig_nezha.fixed: unchanged AST metric/trace kernels; P3 resource wide; log no fabricated severity
orig_nezha.scope: metric+trace partial diagnosis only; full missing-level failure fixture before run

micro.fixed: same allowlisted P3 trace rows; unchanged source arithmetic
factors: Dstar2 versus Ochiai on 88 stored groups, reuse verified hashes
original graph only on repaired partitions
micro.optional: paper prior expression only if pinned local paper image establishes it; no threshold search

hypotheses.H-S1: source branch/preprocessing differs from M4 and changes diagnosis on identical allowed measurements
hypotheses.H-S2: duration and log time contract changes explain all or part of observed source kernel ranking
hypotheses.H-M1: spectrum formula explains some poor repaired MicroRank ranking with same groups and weights
hypotheses.H-M2: upstream graph or partition mismatch changes scores or yields invalid cells

stop: branch stops at identified missing source/input or inability of allowed observations to distinguish explanations, after all feasible registered contrasts; never interpret weak accuracy as impossibility
evaluation: freeze diagnoses before opening label table; compare all22 and13cells, exact-score ties, matched correct/wrong and intermediate chain
